title: Maria's Messages
text:
Maria sends many text messages every day. She writes to her friends, her mother, and her brother. Sometimes she sends a photo with a short message. Her phone is always in her bag.

Last week, Maria got a message from her friend Tom. He asked if she wanted to meet at the cinema on Friday. Maria replied quickly with a smiley face and said yes. They met at six o'clock and had a great time.

options: Her friends, her mother and her brother

questions.text: Who sent Maria a message last week?
How does Maria probably feel about Tom's invitation?
options: She is bored by the idea
She is too tired to answer

questions.text: What kind of relationship do Maria and Tom probably have?

vocabulary.definition: a short piece of written communication sent from one person to another
a picture taken with a camera or phone
a place where you go to watch films
answered someone by saying or writing something

paragraph_translations: Maria wysyła codziennie wiele wiadomości tekstowych. Pisze do swoich przyjaciół, mamy i brata. Czasami wysyła zdjęcie z krótką wiadomością. Jej telefon jest zawsze w torbie.

W zeszłym tygodniu Maria dostała wiadomość od przyjaciela Toma. Zapytał, czy chce spotkać się w kinie w piątek. Maria szybko odpowiedziała uśmiechniętą buźką i powiedziała tak. Spotkali się o szóstej i świetnie się bawili.
